content:
Apple Maps recently added a new "Suggested Places" feature in iOS 26.5, and it will become even more useful in iOS 27.

iOS 27 has greatly improved the "Suggested Places" feature of Apple Maps by adding more recommendations.

When iOS 26.5 launched in May, it brought two Apple Maps-related changes, including "Suggested Places." This feature recommends places worth visiting on the Maps search screen.

"Suggested Places" makes recommendations based on popular trends and your recent search history.

The latter is especially important. That is, if you are planning a trip, Maps will detect it and provide corresponding suggestions based on the location you are researching.

I think "Suggested Places" is a very practical new feature in iOS 26.5, but with one drawback: it only shows two recommendations at a time.

Fortunately, Apple quickly fixed this issue.

The Maps app in iOS 27 still displays two "Suggested Places" on the search screen as before. But now you can swipe horizontally to find more recommendations.

When I tested with the iOS 27 beta, I saw up to 10 recommended places at a time.

I think this improvement is obvious. "Suggested Places" has become more practical, with absolutely no side effects.

Now, whether I want to find new places to try locally or plan future trips elsewhere, the Maps search screen has quickly become my first choice.

In addition to expanding the "Suggested Places" feature, iOS 27 includes several other Apple Maps improvements, which you can learn more about here.

Do you usually use the Apple Maps "Suggested Places" feature? Will iOS 27 change your usage habits? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
